baselineBehavior: one endpoint in the attempt's canonical event-id set (V0S)
correctedBehavior: per-relation ROLE semantics validated against an AttemptRelationContext

RESULT_PROMOTED.destination: a PROMOTION_COMMITTED node carrying the evidence

ATTEMPT_REOPENED_FOR_REWORK.destination: a TASK_READY node carrying the evidence

positiveCoverage.realPromotion: ADMITTED (real canonical Work) — was EXCLUDED at baseline (F2)
positiveCoverage.realGovernedRework: ADMITTED (real canonical Work) — was EXCLUDED at baseline (F3)
positiveCoverage.multipleAttemptsIsolation: A0/A1/promoted each admit only their OWN relations

noGlobalSuppression: every legitimate relation is asserted VISIBLE in the correct Attempt's Preview; negatives are not satisfied by suppressing relations
quarantineScoping: a known-incomplete relation is quarantined only when it touches the requested Attempt; an unrelated unresolved relation is not reported as this Attempt's fact
